question: In the sewage sludge co-incineration run with the highest incineration temperature, what gas velocity and P/Fe/Na ratio were used?
rendered:
The document "Co-Incineration of Real Municipal Sewage Sludge in a Fluidized Bed: Effects of the Coexistence of P, Fe, and Na on Agglomeration and Heavy Metal Emissions" contains the relevant information.

In the table on page 3, the run with the highest incineration temperature (900 °C) is run 3. The gas velocity and P/Fe/Na ratio used in this run are:

- Gas velocity: 1.3× Umf
- P/Fe/Na ratio: 0.4/3/1
